problem_statement: codrops/AmbientCanvasBackgrounds is a static multi-page showcase of animated ambient <canvas> backgrounds (five effects, one per index page) sharing a bare foreground chrome layer: a masthead heading, a GitHub link, Previous Demo / Article links, and a row of effect-name controls that switch between the pages. The chrome sits directly on the animated background with no readability treatment. Reframe the showcase as the Halcyon Signals ambient sound-design studio while preserving every ambient background animation untouched. Rebrand the masthead into 'Halcyon Signals' with a short studio intro line; rename the effect controls into the studio's signal fields (Drift, Eddy, Cadence, Gather, Relay); rebrand the utility links into studio navigation (The Studio / Field Notes / Commissions); add a legibility scrim behind the masthead; and add a four-tile 'field ledger' strip that surfaces per-field session facts. Put a 'field roster' rail on EVERY field page so a visitor always sees the whole set, and wire a 'pin this field' console whose readout must update to the tracked field when the visitor pins it. Keep the five-page structure, the control row that switches pages, and every ambient background effect exactly as-is, with no horizontal overflow at 390px mobile.
required_content: The masthead heading reads 'Halcyon Signals' (an ambient sound-design / generative signal-field studio) with a short studio intro line ('ambient sound-design studio composing generative signal fields') beneath it.

The effect controls are rebranded into the studio's signal fields (Drift, Eddy, Cadence, Gather, Relay) instead of the raw demo names, and the utility links become studio navigation (The Studio / Field Notes / Commissions).
A four-tile 'field ledger' strip surfaces per-field session facts and wraps cleanly with no horizontal overflow at 390px mobile.
A 'field roster' rail listing all five fields is present on EVERY field page (not just the first), tagged per page so cross-page consistency is verifiable.

A 'pin this field' console: clicking the pin control updates its readout to 'Tracking: <current field>' (and toggles the pinned button state); the readout must reflect the pinned field, not stay on the initial 'Tracking: none'.
A readability scrim behind the masthead keeps the foreground chrome legible over the animated background, in a coherent studio palette.
The ambient background animation on every page is preserved unchanged and the control row still switches between the five field pages.
design_constraints: Preserve the ambient background: do not remove, replace, or restyle the background effect scripts or the per-page palette.
Keep the static multi-page structure (index.html .. index5.html) and the control row that navigates between the five pages.
The change is a foreground chrome / readability edit only: masthead, intro copy, field controls, studio navigation, legibility scrim, field-ledger strip, cross-page roster rail, and the pin console.
Rebrand coherently around one fictional persona (Halcyon Signals ambient studio); do not leave a mix of the new wordmark and leftover demo labels.
Do not introduce external stock imagery, remote fonts, analytics, or CDN scripts; the chrome layer stays self-contained and console/network clean.
Mobile chrome must wrap intentionally with no horizontal overflow; do not mask overflow with overflow-x:hidden while leaving the document wider than the viewport.

The field roster rail must appear on all five pages, and the pin console readout must actually track the pinned field (a click that only recolors the button without updating the readout is incorrect).
state_constraints: desktop_home / mobile_home / tablet_home capture the first field page (Drift) with the shared chrome, the field ledger strip, and the field roster rail.

desktop_eddy / mobile_eddy capture the second field page (Eddy / index2.html); desktop_relay captures the fifth field page (Relay / index5.html). The field roster rail must be present on these pages too.

desktop_pin_initial captures the Drift page before any interaction (the pin readout reads 'Tracking: none'); desktop_pin_toggle captures the same page after clicking the pin console (the readout must then read 'Tracking: Drift').

Source inspection confirms the site is a static HTML/CSS/JS multi-page background demo with no build step, no remote assets, and a shared foreground chrome duplicated across the five index pages; the background canvas is position:fixed so it never contributes to the document width.

change_completion: The masthead, intro line, field controls, studio navigation, field ledger, roster rail, and pin console all read as the Halcyon Signals ambient studio across the captured pages.
The raw effect names and demo utility links no longer appear in the chrome, and the field roster rail is present on every field page.
The pin console readout updates to the tracked field when the pin control is clicked.
design_consistency: The field ledger strip, scrim, and roster rail keep the coherent studio palette and typography while preserving the background palette and layout grid.
The chrome reads as one persona (Halcyon Signals), not a mix of new wordmark and leftover demo labels or an off-palette slab.
regression: The ambient background animation still renders on every page (canvas screenshot bytes present).
The five-page control row and static serving still work without a custom server, and the preserved shell keeps the Halcyon Signals wordmark.
responsive: 390px mobile has no horizontal overflow and the field ledger strip wraps cleanly (overflow is repaired, not masked with overflow-x:hidden).
The masthead, intro line, field controls, and ledger strip stay readable and correctly stacked across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static ambient-background restyle/cross_page task on codrops AmbientCanvasBackgrounds, hardened to L4. The ambient background is preserved (regression); the graded change is the foreground Halcyon Signals chrome/readability layer across css/chrome.css, the five index*.html and js/hs-pin.js. INFRA (identical all legs): neutralize the base.css global body overflow clamp so the mobile overflow is measurable, and pin the serif type to a system serif stack. baseline = the graded defect leg (Halcyon wordmark + field ledger present, but the ledger is a fixed 760px nowrap row that overflows the phone, the tiles are off-palette, and the roster rail is on page 1 only) -> FAILS no_horizontal_overflow + visual_regression + dom_assertions but PASSES the pin interaction. bad = the smart-wrong leg: it rebrands fully AND carries the ledger + roster rail + pin console, but (1) narrows the ledger to 560px + overflow-x:hidden on the row (masked not fixed, still +190px overflow), (2) leaves the tiles off-palette (teal slab), (3) renders the roster rail on page 1 only, and (4) wires the pin toggle to flip the .is-pinned class but never re-sync #hs-pin-readout (the click succeeds but the readout stays 'Tracking: none') -> FAILS FOUR orthogonal gates (no_horizontal_overflow + visual_regression + dom_assertions + interaction_assertions) while its text/completion signals PASS. All three legs are console/network clean and background-preserving. The background canvas is position:fixed (0 document scrollWidth) and deterministic under headless swiftshader, so the D3/D6 levers are canvas-independent (ref-vs-ref screenshot diff = 0).

metadata.selected_repo_reason: codrops AmbientCanvasBackgrounds is a runnable static multi-page ambient-background showcase with a bare demo chrome layer duplicated across five pages, making it an ideal host for an L4 regression_continuity restyle that rebrands the foreground chrome, adds a cross-page studio roster rail and an interactive pin console, and repairs the mobile chrome while preserving every ambient background effect.
